sobre: Mobilelegis is a platform for consulting Mozambican legislation, developed by Law Technology Solutions, Lda (LTS).
It brings together legal acts and their amendments in a single consolidated version, organised by area, category and subcategory.
privacidade: Personal data is collected solely to manage your account, subscriptions and invoicing.
You can view, correct or delete your data at any time from the Personal details menu.
termos: Access to the platform requires registration and, after the free trial, a subscription plan or the purchase of legal acts.
Consolidated versions are for reference only; the official publication in the Boletim da República prevails.

faqs.q: How long is the free trial?
faqs.a: 14 days of free access to the areas chosen when registering.

faqs.q: Can I buy a legal act without subscribing?
faqs.a: Yes. Any legal act can be bought individually, even if your account is blocked.
M-Pesa, E-Mola and mKesh. The invoice is sent to your email.

faqs.q: What is the difference between the Basic and Unlimited plans?
faqs.a: The Basic plan gives access to a limited number of areas of your choice; the Unlimited plan gives access to the whole platform.
